title: 耶鲁管理学院执行研究员：马斯克财富堪比洛克菲勒，但权力更甚
speaker: William D. Cohan

segments.en: He's an executive fellow, excuse me, at the Yale School of Management. All right, break it down.
segments.zh: 他是耶鲁管理学院的执行研究员。好，来分析一下。

segments.en: It's hard to compare Musk to kings and queens and heads of state because they had things at their disposal and hard currencies that he kind of doesn't.
segments.zh: 很难将马斯克与国王、女王或国家元首相提并论，因为他们拥有他无法企及的资源和硬通货。

segments.en: But is this kind of private citizen wealth unprecedented in the monitored, written history of the world?
segments.zh: 但这种私人财富规模在有记载的世界历史中是否前所未有？

segments.en: John D. Rockefeller probably controlled roughly the same size of US GDP in terms of his wealth compared to the scale of the country.
segments.zh: 约翰·D·洛克菲勒的财富占美国GDP的比例，大概与马斯克相当。

segments.en: The estimates vary, but two and a half to three percent, so he was somewhere between a little bit below Musk and a little bit above.
segments.zh: 估算值在2.5%到3%之间，所以他略低于或略高于马斯克。

segments.en: The corner of the realm here is power, as you point out, in your piece.
segments.zh: 正如你在文章中所指出的，核心在于权力。

segments.en: That's what you can get if you have a lot of money.
segments.zh: 这就是你拥有巨额财富所能得到的。

segments.en: We've seen Elon Musk exercise that before he became a trillionaire.
segments.zh: 我们在埃隆·马斯克成为万亿富翁之前就见过他行使这种权力。
